body.name: Exact-uniform local projection moments
body.construction: With \(\langle f,g\rangle_h=H^{-1}\int_{Q_h}fg\), define \(V_l=H^{-1}\mathbb E[\mathbf 1\{X\in Q_h\}B_l(X)AY]-\langle P_{h,\ell}(B_l\pi),P_{h,\ell}m\rangle_h\) and \(W_{lr}=H^{-1}\mathbb E[\mathbf 1\{X\in Q_h\}B_l(X)B_r(X)A]-\langle P_{h,\ell}(B_l\pi),P_{h,\ell}(B_r\pi)\rangle_h\).
